notes.title: OPTIMIZATION UPDATE!
notes.notes:
This update contains more optimizations:
-Ferentari Map
-Outside of the Mansion
-Inside Mansion

Fore few people(3 that I know) had some issues with Fatal Error Crash! Usually this is because DIREXTX 12, and for some hardware it can cause crashes when alt tab or windowed, because of not up to date with the graphics card drivers, so I changed to DIRECTX 11 for more stability for everyone.
 Thank you again!

notes.title: IMPORTANT Update 4!
notes.notes:
Because more and more people are buying my game, I rushed as fast as I could to add English subtitles everywhere, so that the story can be understood by everyone!
Now the descriptions of the items are also in English.
Achievement moved to not spoil.
Font menu for logo updated.
Radios and TV have subtitles from the beginning!
THIS IS AN INSANE EXPERIENCE! THANK YOU! LOVE YOU ALL!

notes.title: THANK YOU CASEOH!
notes.notes: [h1]THANK YOU, CASEOH, FOR EVERYTHING!![/h1][p]This is amazing, in the first place, as a solo dev, for seeing my game and then playing it until the end![/p][p]I feel like I'm in a dream! Even thou this game is more focused on Romanian players, I tried to expand it  for everyone. It starts with comedy, Romanian memes that only Romanians will understand. Even with all of this, Caseoh finishes it! This is my first attempt at making a game more serious and horror-filled! [/p][p]I promise you that I will do better and bigger!\\[/p][p]It's an amazing journey and I WANT TO THANK EVERYONE!![/p][p]First time that I'm breaking the barriers, and a popular streamer plays my game![/p][p]LOVE YOU ALL![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Left By Angels is in the Top 20 New & Trending – Indie!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to share that [b]Left By Angels[/b] has officially reached the [b]Top 20 in Steam’s New & Trending Indie Games[/b]![/p][p]This means the world to us — we’re a small team, and seeing [i]Left By Angels[/i] gain this kind of momentum so soon after launch is surreal. Whether you’ve played the game, added it to your wishlist, or simply shared it with a friend, [b]thank you[/b]. Your support is making a real difference.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720950/Left_By_Angels/"][/dynamiclink]💬 Help Us Keep the Momentum Going![/p][p]If you’ve already played and enjoyed the game, leaving a short [b]Steam review[/b] helps us [b]immensely[/b]. Reviews don’t just provide feedback — they help other players discover the game too.[/p][p]❤️ Thank you again for helping [i]Left By Angels[/i] rise. This is only the beginning.[/p][p]– Street Art Studios - Stefan Zet![/p]
